phi.title: Patient Happiness Index
phi.subtitle: The combined experience score for completed submissions, 0 to 100.
phi.headline: Index
phi.methodologyBody: Each rating is mapped onto 0 to 100. Ratings are averaged within a category, categories are equally weighted, and the weights are renormalised across the categories a patient actually scored. Ratings marked "Not applicable" are left out of both the total and the count. Comments never change this number.
phi.contributionHint: Each category's average score and the number of responses behind it.
phi.compatibilityBody: Only submissions scored under the same survey version and scoring policy are comparable. Different sets of services used change the mix of categories, so compare like with like.

report.title: Hospital patient experience report
report.overviewHint: Patient-reported experience for the selected reporting period and authorized scope.
report.completionNote: Completion rate = completed submissions / total submissions. Public QR feedback has no invitation denominator; this is not a patient response rate.
report.servicesHint: Services with scored responses in this period. Unrated services have no score.
report.coverageNote: Coverage = submissions with a scored service / total submissions. Different service usage affects comparability. Categories from different survey versions may appear separately.
report.sampleNote: Scores for groups smaller than {count} responses are withheld. Counts remain visible; no missing score is treated as zero.
report.limited: Showing {shown} of {total} rows to keep the report within five pages.
report.ratingsHint: Rating distributions count individual answers; weekly indices summarize completed submissions.
report.trendUnavailable: Weekly trends are unavailable for this filtered scope. Other report sections retain the selected scope.
report.recentWeeks: The latest 12 weeks with responses are shown; overview totals cover the entire selected period.
report.ratingsNote: 1 is the lowest rating and 5 the highest. These are answer counts, not unique patients. Week boundaries follow the existing dashboard aggregation.
report.branchesHint: Branch figures reflect the same reporting period, visit filters, and staff access.
report.comparisonNote: Branch and service populations may differ. These figures support service improvement and should not be used as clinical-quality rankings.
report.methodologyHint: Read these notes alongside all reported scores and counts.
report.methodScore: Each 1–5 answer maps to 0–100 using ((rating − 1) / 4) × 100. Service scores average scored answers in each category. Patient indices combine category scores using the stored scoring policy; the hospital score averages eligible completed indices.
report.methodMissing: Skipped and not-applicable answers are excluded. Weights are renormalized over answered categories. Incomplete submissions receive no official index. Comments never affect the numerical score.
report.versionNote: This report combines the survey and scoring-policy versions represented in the selected period. Category display labels use the latest published survey. Compare compatible cohorts before drawing conclusions.
report.privacyNote: This is an aggregate staff report. It excludes patient comments, contact details, identifiers, and individual responses. Share the downloaded file only with authorized recipients.
report.limitations: These scores measure reported patient experience, not treatment outcomes or validated clinical quality. Public QR feedback is unverified, and the report cannot establish how many eligible patients chose not to respond.
